deliverables.title: Midterm Examination
deliverables.notes: Covers Chapters 1–6. Closed-book format (true/false, multiple-choice, short-answer). No make-up midterm; missed midterm weight is automatically transferred to the final exam. If final exam grade exceeds midterm grade, midterm weight (35%) shifts to the final exam (making final worth 85%).

deliverables.due_date_expression: December 11–22, to be scheduled by the Registrar's Office
deliverables.notes: Comprehensive, covering all course material. Closed-book format. Weight may increase to 85% if final exam grade exceeds midterm grade. Minimum assessment grade of 50% required to pass the course. Makeup (Special Examination) available only with approved academic consideration.
